# PetMD

> PetMD is a comprehensive veterinary health resource providing vet-written advice, diagnostic tools, and detailed guides for pet owners across all life stages.

PetMD offers evidence-based pet health information authored by licensed veterinarians and veterinary specialists. The site features interactive tools like symptom checkers and toxicity calculators alongside detailed reference guides for conditions, medications, and emergency care.

## Key Topics

- Pet Health
- Dog Care
- Veterinary Advice
- Dog Conditions & Diseases
- Puppy Training
- Dog Nutrition
- Flea & Tick Prevention
- Heartworm Prevention
- Pet Safety
- Emergency Guide
- Dog Allergies
- Symptom Guide
- Dog Behavior
- Pet Anxiety
- Toxicity & Poisoning

## Dog Life Stage Guides

- [Puppies](https://www.petmd.com/dog/puppy): Comprehensive puppy care guide covering training, health, vaccinations, grooming
- [Adult Dogs](https://www.petmd.com/dog/adult): Adult dog health guide with nutrition, behavior, conditions, and allergies info
- [Senior Dogs](https://www.petmd.com/dog/senior): Senior dog care guide covering nutrition, wellness, aging, and behavior changes

## Health Conditions & Symptoms

- [Dog Conditions and Diseases](https://www.petmd.com/dog/conditions): Directory of dog diseases and conditions with expert veterinary guidance
- [Symptoms & What They Mean](https://www.petmd.com/dog/symptoms): Dog symptom index and reference guide for health concerns and when to worry
- [Allergies](https://www.petmd.com/dog/allergies): Dog allergy reference covering symptoms, treatments, food, seasonal, and skin

## Preventive Care & Medications

- [Flea & Tick](https://www.petmd.com/dog/medications/flea-tick): Flea and tick prevention guide with medication options and treatment strategies
- [Heartworm](https://www.petmd.com/dog/medications/heartworm): Heartworm disease treatment and prevention guide with medication information
- [Pet Anxiety](https://www.petmd.com/dog/medications/anxiety): Dog anxiety management guide covering medications and calming aid options

## Nutrition & Safety

- [Dog Nutrition Center](https://www.petmd.com/dog/centers/nutrition): Dog nutrition hub covering food safety, diet, toxicity, and feeding guidelines
- [Poison & Toxicity](https://www.petmd.com/dog/emergency/poisoning-toxicity): Emergency guide to toxic substances, poisoning prevention, and symptom treatment
- [Dog Chocolate Toxicity Meter](https://www.petmd.com/dog/chocolate-toxicity): Interactive chocolate toxicity calculator and emergency guide for dogs

## Training & Behavior

- [Training & Behavior](https://www.petmd.com/dog/behavior): Dog training and behavior guide covering obedience, anxiety, and problems

## General Care & Procedures

- [Care & Healthy Living](https://www.petmd.com/dog/care): Dog care guide with health, training, nutrition, flea prevention, behavior
- [Common Pet Procedures](https://www.petmd.com/hub/common-pet-procedures): Guide to common pet surgeries, diagnostic tests, costs, and recovery timelines

## Home

- [PetMD Homepage](https://www.petmd.com): PetMD homepage: vet-written pet health advice, symptom checker, toxicity tools
